settings.question: How much does it cost to move a fridge in Sydney?
settings.answer: It depends on the size of the fridge, stairs or a lift at either end, the distance and the time you need it done. Call 0469 717 535 with those details and you get a fixed price on the phone, with no hourly meter and no surprise fees.

settings.question: Do you move fridges upright?
settings.answer: Yes, always. Our fridge movers keep every fridge upright on an appliance trolley and strap it upright in the van. We never lay a fridge on its side.

settings.question: How long should I wait before turning my fridge back on?
settings.answer: Because we keep it upright, the wait is short. As a simple rule, let it stand for a couple of hours before you plug it in, and check your fridge manual for the exact time. A fridge that has been laid down needs much longer.

settings.question: Can you move a fridge up or down stairs?
settings.answer: Yes. Tell us how many flights and whether there is a turn or landing. Two movers take it one step at a time on a stair-rated trolley, with the fridge strapped so it cannot tip.

settings.question: Will my French-door fridge fit through the doorway?
settings.answer: Measure the tightest doorway and the fridge depth before you call. If it is close, French-door handles and sometimes the doors can be removed to get through. We plan it on the phone so there are no surprises on the day.

settings.question: Do I need to empty and defrost the fridge first?
settings.answer: Yes. Empty it, take out loose shelves and drawers, and turn it off the night before so the freezer can defrost and dry. It keeps the fridge lighter and stops water leaking in the van.

settings.question: Can you pick up a fridge I bought on Marketplace or Gumtree?
settings.answer: Yes. Give us the seller's suburb and a pickup time. We collect it, check it is standing upright and bring it to your kitchen.

settings.question: Can you collect a new fridge from the store?
settings.answer: Yes. Once it is paid for, we collect it from the store or warehouse with your order number and deliver it, often the same day.

settings.question: Do you connect the water line or ice maker?
settings.answer: We place the fridge in position and plug it in if you like. Plumbed-in water lines and ice makers should be connected by a licensed plumber.

settings.question: Can you take my old fridge away?
settings.answer: We can move your old fridge to another address, a family member, a buyer or a storage unit. Tell us when you call.

settings.question: Can you move a fridge the same day?
settings.answer: Often, yes. Call before midday and we'll check what we can do today, 7 days a week.

settings.question: Is my fridge insured while you move it?
settings.answer: Yes. Your fridge is covered while it is in our care, strapped and wrapped in our van.

settings.local_heading: Your Fridge Arrives Working, Your Home Without a Scratch
settings.local_body:
A fridge is one of the heaviest and most fragile things in your home. Lay it down, drop it on a step or let the doors swing open, and you can end up with a dented door, a cracked shelf, a gouged floor or a fridge that will not cool.

That is why our fridge movers follow the same routine on every job: the fridge stays upright the whole way, it rides on a proper appliance trolley, the doors are strapped shut, and it is wrapped in thick moving blankets before it leaves the room. Two movers control it on every step, in every lift and through every doorway, and it is strapped to the wall of the van so it cannot shift in transit.

At your place we protect door frames and floors, carry it into the kitchen, garage or laundry you choose and stand it in position, ready for you to plug in. Your fridge is covered while it is in our care.
